lines: Skill text fixes: the Sparks and Wayward Orb now show how long they last and how many enemies they jump to, Thousand Sparks shows its number of flights again, and Recent Patch hovers for Charges and stacks (Fury, Resolve, Insight, ...) show their numbers instead of {0}.
The updated FAQ lines are now translated in every page language.

FAQ brought up to date: any Cold chills again (Patch 72), Multistrike's 56% less, on a Guardian only the strongest curse, Mark or Banner counts and only one shock, and the Privacy page now covers accounts.

Accounts: Sign in with Discord (top right, next to Language) to save your build plans to an account. They open on every device you sign in on and stay in step as you edit. Optional: everything else works without signing in.

The builder has a new address: builder.lilshrimper.dev. The old address forwards there, and the first time it does, your plans, loaded characters, loot filters and settings come with you. Old share links keep working.
Privacy, Terms and Contact pages: added how the optional Discord accounts for saving plans work. Accounts are being tested and are not switched on for everyone yet.
Plans: this browser now keeps up to 200 build plans. Before, plans and loaded characters shared 60 places, so old plans could drop off the list.
Item Simulator: in the Item lines table, a unique effect the sim counts now says so ("in the sim") with the skills it counts for, and a minion pulse (Storm Choir, Restless Gale) shows its own DPS.
Grail: a new Signature runes section lists each Guardian's signature rune and how many you hold.
Item Search: a signature rune's card now names its Guardian (for example "The Demon Warlord's signature rune"), and searching a Guardian's name finds its rune.
Translated pages: about 800 game names that went back to English with patch 76 (newer skills and uniques) are translated again.
Translated pages: the Loot Filter tab, the minion cards on Minion Scaling, the Recent Patch headings and the Save Creator intro are now translated.
Loot Filter: the preset message now reads " Made an endgame filter.

Loot Filter: each rule now has the game's More conditions (rune rows, line tier, lines, sockets, item and required level ranges, grade, reds, unsworn, named bases and reds). Named lines still have to be set in the game; codes that have them keep them.
Loot Filter: the game's own presets (All loot, Tidy, Strict, Very strict, End Game) load with one click.
Loot Filter: all 8 highlight colours and all 5 sounds; codes now match what the game's Copy filter gives.
New Loot Filter tab: build up to 12 rules and copy the code into the game's filter panel, or paste a code from the game to edit it. Share a filter with a link.
Loot Filter: test an item to see which rule decides it, and warnings for rules that are never reached.
Loot Filter: start from a preset (Levelling, Mid-game, Endgame, SSF), fitted to the character on screen: its skill, damage type and missing resistances.
Damage: the Focus keystone (main skill 25% more, other skills 40% less) and Convergence (one Spark skill: Sparks on Rares and Guardians strike up to 50% faster), from the patch 74 and 76 notes.
Recent Patch: hover the Effectiveness words for what they mean; changed numbers note a rough buff or nerf.
Character tab: each skill card has Include in Sim and Mark as Main boxes.
Character tab: Sim Supports on a skill card opens the skill window, so you can pin or block supports before you run the search there.
Support tooltips in the skill window and in the Sim Supports results.
Save as new build (next to Copy share link): saves what you see as a plan under a name you pick.
Character list: a × on each entry removes it from the list (a plan is deleted after a confirm; a removed save comes back when you load it again).

Item tooltips: gem level lines now name their type (Nightshade: "+3 to Level of all Poison Skill Gems", the same for Fire, Cold and Lightning runewords and uniques). Crit, area and damage-taken lines that dropped their type show it too.
Translations: these lines, and negative damage-taken lines ("You take -40% increased Poison Damage"), are now translated in every page language.

Minions: their poison now counts in the vs-enemy DPS. Blows poison at the base 10% plus the summon gem's own supports (Venom), one enemy holds 40 stacks from your whole army and the strongest stay. Fitted to one Training Post test (game log, 14 Nov); the game's panel leaves it out.

Sleepy's Continental Strap: its poison burst now counts for minions. Every 12th poison your army lays hits for the belt's share of what the stacks still hold; each summon shows its part. On the tested army about a fifth more damage.
